_about: Every figure published on the README has an entry here. The internal register replays each one against live evidence; a claim whose check fails blocks publication.
_note: Verification commands run in the source repository and are not reproduced here: they reference its private layout. What this file commits to is the list itself — an assertion missing from it is an assertion nothing guards.
